# Bloomberg

> > Bloomberg delivers business and financial information, news, and insights around the world through the Bloomberg Professional service, Bloomberg Terminal, and digital platforms.

Bloomberg is a global leader in financial data, analytics, and media. The Bloomberg Professional service (Bloomberg Terminal) provides real-time market data, trading capabilities, and research tools to finance professionals worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Bloomberg Professional
- Bloomberg Terminal
- Bloomberg SID
- Account Billing
- Invoice Access
- Billing Information
- Account Reports
- Accounts Receivable
- Financial Data Services
- Market Analytics
- Professional Services Portal

## Account Management & Billing

- [Account Billing](https://service.bloomberg.com/portal/bobis/index): Bloomberg Professional account billing, invoices, and receivables portal
